tasks.description: Builds a patch plan from the open issues of an issue export, checking the listed files against the repository. Use when asked for a patch plan for the open issues of a repository.
tasks.intent: Plan patches for open issues ordered by severity and grouped by component.

tasks.description: Finds stale and merged branches in a branch export using the staleness window of the export. Use when asked for a stale branch report for a repository.
tasks.intent: Report stale, merged and far-behind branches from a branch export.

tasks.description: Drafts release notes from conventional commit subjects since the last release and proposes the next version. Use when asked to draft release notes for the next version of a repository.
tasks.intent: Draft release notes grouped by change type from the commit list.
